candidates.label: 003-exact-corner-tests
candidates.summary: F1 link-flag GHZ frame (flip qubit F = g_b), parent r02-F1-002 with the fold/NOR flag X1 and the closed-pair check Y1..Y3 replaced by one exact bright test: frame as in the parent (link prep, U_E on L2, corner CX+CCX, r in R2 slots, h_b mux with K1/z selectors, CX tau fix, relative-phase CCH, deltas, closed GHZ gadget; the c3 test literal e1 ^ delta_c3 merged into the tau fix at no cost); flag x = AND_c [e1_c = 0 and (e2_c or delta_c)], closed pair included, from three in-place quadratic tests on the delta registers (delta ^ e2 & !(e1 ^ delta)), corner c2 as the literal !e1 before and after one in-place fold, and a 5-input rccx chain (26 CX per side instead of 30); the uniformly controlled Rz on F needs only 6 Gray-cycle Walsh terms over (x, K1, z); all angles linear in alpha, beta, sqrt2 beta.
